exposure: sporadic fetal heart rate accelerations during labor
periodic fetal heart rate accelerations during labor
normal fetal heart rate variability (5-25 beats per minute)
outcome: Acidemia at birth (cord blood pH <7.05 at vaginal birth, or pH <7.10 at birth after first stage cesarean delivery)
cohort: Neonates (364 with acidemia at birth and 731 controls)
finding: Sporadic accelerations during labor indicate a very low probability of acidosis in newborns.
